title: Press Release Distribution by Industry | PressCosmos
description: Industry-specific press release distribution with dedicated media lists, keyword guidance and specialist reviewers across twelve sectors.

Industries

Every sector has its own definition of news.

A clinical milestone and a store opening are both announcements. They do not read the same, they do not go to the same desks, and the editor who reviews them should not be the same person.

Submit a releaseSee pricing
Quick answer PressCosmos distributes press releases across twelve industry verticals: technology, SaaS, finance and banking, crypto and Web3, healthcare and life sciences, real estate, education and edtech, travel and hospitality, automotive and mobility, entertainment and media, legal and professional services, and e-commerce and retail. Each vertical has its own media list, keyword guidance and specialist reviewer.
